result.summary: Found 1 minor visual layout issue where the text at the bottom of the restaurant card is vertically clipped.

issues.description: Text descenders and the bottom of characters are clipped in the 'Popular right now' card details (e.g., the letter 'n' in 'Ramen' and 'y' in 'delivery' are cut off).
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container height, line-height, or padding to ensure full text readability without vertical clipping.
